fixed_model.state: same saved ray normalized in expectation formulas; no state regeneration
fixed_model.cost_metric: compiled full Hadamard wrapper RZ; preparation cost excluded

approval_required: Explicit approval of this finite saved-data analysis package, including a minimal reuse adapter/artificial validation/SOURCE fixation before dataset evaluation; current instruction does not grant execution

residual.units: measurement signal expectation after B_saved scale on normalized ray
residual.definition: rho_ca >= |m_actual_compiled_ca - m_C_normalized_ca|; includes remaining encoded/literal/compiler/phase/scale/preparation correspondence gaps
residual.base_allowance: C saved axes[i].bias_distance.upper directly, not C total
residual.bias_reference: old saved signed_bias; C distance binds same-ray physical bias to that reference

accounting.reuse: fixed_signal_accounting.fixed_signal_shots; original precision_accounting guard logic; _statistics and weighted paired sample method reused without invoking Hamiltonian/circuit evaluation
accounting.rho_guard_formula: g*(epsilon_axis-|b0|)/(1+g)-u_enc; g=0.01; negative means no admissible nonnegative residual under policy
accounting.B_upper_policy: B_up=max(1,B_saved,exp(saved_log_B_upper)); log_up=max(0,log(B_saved),saved_log_B_upper) with outward scalar verification in new version; fixed B_saved readout never changed
accounting.safe_rounding: Retain original floating evaluator output as diagnostic; validate scalar sufficient inequality with exact/outward inputs. Inflate only the new-version sufficient N to the scalar ceiling when necessary, or leave null with NUMERICAL_BOUND_UNRESOLVED. Never call this a certificate.
accounting.safe_integer_limit: Reuse original shots<2**52 representation policy; larger bound reported symbolically/null, not zero
accounting.evidence_kind: EMPIRICAL / conditional diagnostic even when using C enclosure; formal certificate flag false
accounting.error_label: C encoded-enclosure evidence plus explicitly assumed residual budget; residual is not observed, estimated or certified by this plan

statistical_plan.variance: s_G^2/Nmc for Z_i=N_cos*C_i_cos+N_sin*C_i_sin; equivalent N^T S N/Nmc, retain covariance
statistical_plan.interval: existing nominal Student-t95 diagnostic; conditional on fixed error/nuisance inputs and IID trajectories; not rigorous tail/population/worst-case bound
statistical_plan.conditional_G: sum_a N_a(rho)*mu_Ca, sample estimate uses unchanged paired prices
statistical_plan.population_uncertainty: Keep eta_cost or stratum means/envelopes symbolic if no valid whole-wrapper bound exists; no zero-fill for unseen orders/components
statistical_plan.strata: Trajectory-level mutually exclusive strata: any order4; no order4 but any component in descriptive previously-unobserved set U; remainder. U is data-selected and cannot support new rigorous frequentist coverage by itself.
statistical_plan.law: Use existing effective order/component masses from C if encoded event join validates IID product law; nominal masses separately labelled. No PCG64 replay or new independence proof imposed.
statistical_plan.rare_mass_formula: For M=q*r, p4=1-(1-pi4)^M; pU_no4=(1-pi4)^M-[sum_{k in {0,2}} pi_k*(1-mU)^(k+1)]^M under the fixed IID event law
statistical_plan.full_wrapper_tail: If genuine L_h<=cost|h<=U_h available, use mixture envelopes. Otherwise retain mu_h variables; empirical observed maxima or additive event costs are not U_h.

comparisons.primary: PR vs PF within each representation at each precision
comparisons.secondary: Other four-way pairwise comparisons labelled fixed implementations/partitions; no DF-only causal effect or optimized-method claim
comparisons.residual_domains: rho axis variables independent; common rho percase conservative display slice only
comparisons.landmarks: Set rho_case=theta*min_axis(rho_guard) only if domain nonempty; equal theta across methods is not equal physical rho; zero landmark hypothetical
comparisons.root_method: Monotone piecewise-ceil functions with analytic/interval break-even brackets; do not smooth away ceil or claim global ordering from a common-theta slice
comparisons.robustness: Report PR-favourable/PF-favourable/reversal/unresolved regions under declared residual and cost-tail envelopes; nominal-t-only regions explicitly labelled empirical
comparisons.hypothesis_failures: Do not relabel guard failure as a general scientific impossibility

Verify input SHA and fixed case/axis/cost/event joins; new package must not import original molecular or compiler entrypoints
Approval must bind this exact package and input manifest; fresh grant required; none issued in planning
resources: Reuse cached small saved arrays and scalar arithmetic; select practical parallelism if useful; no arbitrary CPU/RAM/worker cap, unsafe Arb threaded context or shared-environment changes

policy_change: New evaluation version under formally adopted conditional resource-comparison policy; original guard/conditions/results/STOP/null retained
